name: helpers_side_by_side
title: Two sources compared, each read by a helper alongside

steps.say: compare my two lead sources side by side: how many leads each has and their total value; have a helper read each one
steps.reply:
South has more leads and the larger total.

| | Leads North | Leads South |
|---|---|---|
| Leads | 2 | 3 |
| Total value | 42,000 | 58,000 |
| Average per lead | 21,000 | about 19,300 |
| Largest lead | Birch Labs (30,000) | Delta Freight (45,000) |

- **North:** Acme Tools 12,000 and Birch Labs 30,000.
- **South:** Cedar Foods 8,000, Delta Freight 45,000 and Elm Studio 5,000.

Together they come to 5 leads worth 100,000. Every value is filled in and is a number.

A helper read each list on its own, and nothing was changed.

arg.rubric: Passes if the answer says Leads North has 2 leads worth 42,000 in total and Leads South has 3 leads worth 58,000 in total (or the same in other words). Fails if a count or total is wrong.
arg.facts: Leads North: Acme Tools 12,000 and Birch Labs 30,000 (2 leads, 42,000). Leads South: Cedar Foods 8,000, Delta Freight 45,000, Elm Studio 5,000 (3 leads, 58,000).

checks.why: The answer says Leads North has 2 leads worth 42,000 and Leads South has 3 leads worth 58,000, which matches the person's data.
